guard: The cwd-inode credential-mirror pin verifies the directory it entered and restores the working directory it moved
why: THIS CONFIG IS NOT GRADABLE ON LINUX, and its two mutants fail differently rather than both
surviving. `pinMode` returns "procfs-fd" on linux, so `#assertCwdIsPinned` never runs and
`#entryCwd` is never set. Measured on ubuntu at 1a330c7a: the swapped-parent mutant is
UNGRADABLE, the suite stays green at 23/23 and nothing in the file is killed. The restore
mutant WRONG-REDs rather than surviving: with `#entryCwd` undefined the flipped condition
calls `process.chdir(undefined)`, which throws in an earlier cell, so the run exits 1 without
ever printing the assertion registered for it. A red here is not a kill, and a reader who
takes it for one records coverage this platform does not have.
Run it on macOS or a BSD, where the pin actually executes. No CI job executes it: every lane
that runs a smoke suite is ubuntu-latest, and the macos-latest job in installer.yml runs

mutations.name: cwd-inode pin trusts the directory it entered
mutations.find:
if (!sameInode(statSync("."), fstatSync(this.#fd)))
      throw new Error(`refusing swapped Jcode credential mirror parent: ${displayPath}`);
mutations.replace: if (false) throw new Error(`refusing swapped Jcode credential mirror parent: ${displayPath}`);
mutations.expectRed: a directory swapped between the pin open and the pin entry never unlinks outside
mutations.cell: a directory swapped between the pin open and the pin entry never unlinks outside

mutations.name: cwd-inode pin leaks the working directory it moved
mutations.replace: if (this.#entryCwd === undefined) process.chdir(this.#entryCwd as unknown as string);
mutations.expectRed: credential mirroring restores the working directory, including when it refuses
mutations.cell: credential mirroring restores the working directory, including when it refuses
